title: User access changed
description: One user's effective access, recomputed by Platform from direct grants and role assignments across every app. Consumers store one row per user and never join roles themselves. A consumer upserts by user id when `version` is newer. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

tenant_id.description: The reserved platform tenant for a platform-scope user.

keycloak_subject.description: The Keycloak user id the token subject carries.

permissions.description: Every effective permission code, across all apps, such as billing:invoice:read.
